spec.description:
ProctorGeo IRMA is a heavy-duty, water-vapour
permeable non-woven geotextile membrane specifically engineered as a protective
and water-dispersing separation layer for Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies
(IRMA), green roofs, and protected membrane roofs. Manufactured from
high-tenacity, UV-stabilised virgin polypropylene fibers, it is installed loose
over extruded polystyrene (XPS) insulation boards beneath gravel ballast or
pavers. It prevents dirt, ballast fines, and silt from washing into insulation
joints while allowing water vapour to vent freely, mitigating rain water cooling
and maintaining roof thermal efficiency.
features:
Engineered
specifically for Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies (IRMA) and ballast green
roofs

High water-vapour permeability prevents moisture entrapment above
insulation boards

Functions as an effective filter layer preventing silt and
ballast fines from bridging joints

Reduces rain water cooling effect by
draining up to 98% of runoff above insulation

High tensile and CBR puncture
resistance withstands rough gravel ballast and pavers

UV-stabilised virgin
polypropylene construction resists rot, mildew, and soil chemicals

Dimensionally stable, lightweight, and easy to roll out over XPS insulation
boards
Non-toxic, chemically inert, and safe for rainwater catchment systems

technical.value:
2.0 m or 3.0 m width x 50 m / 100 m
length

spec.fire:
Tested for low flammability as an
unexposed filtration layer under non-combustible ballast or pavers
spec.compliance:
EN 13252, AS 3706 series, NCC 2022 Volume One Section J inverted
roof provisions
spec.sustainability:
100% recyclable virgin polypropylene; zero
ODP; chemically inert
install:
Complete primary roof waterproofing
membrane and ensure watertightness testing is verified

Lay extruded
polystyrene (XPS) rigid insulation boards tightly butted over the
waterproofing

Roll out ProctorGeo IRMA geotextile loose directly over the top
of the XPS insulation

Ensure all adjoining geotextile runs overlap by a
minimum of 300mm

Turn geotextile up all parapets, upstands, and penetrations
to the height of the ballast finish

Place rounded gravel ballast
(minimum 50mm depth) or paving slabs on pedestals directly over the fabric

Ensure ballast is placed progressively to prevent wind uplift of the geotextile
during installation
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof design is an
Inverted Roof Membrane Assembly (IRMA) with XPS insulation above waterproofing

Verify ballast type (washed round river gravel 16-32mm or pavers on
pedestals)

Calculate total roof area allowing for minimum 300mm overlaps and
parapet upturns
Confirm drainage outlets have gravel guard cages installed
accessories:
Extruded polystyrene (XPS) insulation boards (e.g. DCT XPS
/ Kingspan GG300)
limitations:
Not a waterproofing membrane; designed strictly as
a filtration, water-deflecting, and separation geotextile

Must be weighed
down with ballast or pavers to prevent wind uplift

Do not use crushed, sharp
aggregate ballast that could pierce the fabric
spec.warranty:
Backed by
Proctor Group Australia manufacturer warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorGeo IRMA is a heavy-duty, water-vapour permeable non-woven geotextile
engineered specifically as a filter, separation, and water-deflecting layer for
Inverted Roof Membrane Assemblies (IRMA). Laid loose directly over extruded
polystyrene (XPS) insulation beneath gravel ballast or pavers, its virgin
polypropylene fiber matrix filters out silt and prevents ballast fines from
jamming board joints while allowing vapor to vent freely. By shedding up to 98%
of surface rainwater directly to outlets, it minimizes rainwater cooling to
preserve the thermal performance of flat concrete roofs.
